policy_summary: The official fair-data-usage policy says free CSV/Excel data are intended for private individuals for personal betting and/or academic interest/research only, via manual download or at most light automated download (maximum twice per week). It says the data are not intended for commercial or AI data-training projects. It does not expressly define frozen-weight inference; this project treats only noncommercial personal/academic research inference as within the stated scope, and blocks training, commercial use and public product publication.
policy_interpretation: Operational interpretation only, not a provider-issued AI-inference licence: frozen-weight inference using current-season statistics solely as lagged features, with no fitting/refitting/selection, no commercial use and no public product publication, is treated as personal/academic research. If intended use becomes a public product, commercial service or training project, this manifest does not permit it and the source must not be used for that purpose.
